svg.title: Figure 2 | Five Steps in a Requirements Interview
svg.desc: Arrows show the investigation and verification sequence, not established findings. Confirm the need in step 3 with users; compare task time and error counts in step 5.

g.font-family: Arial, Noto Sans CJK TC, sans-serif
g.text: Figure 2 | Five Steps in a Requirements Interview
② Ask about the actual event
“At which step was it slow the last time?”
“We want to avoid entering the same information repeatedly.”
“Automatically filling existing data may reduce the work.”
“Try a prototype and compare task time and error counts.”
